# FDGA012

> DO NOT use spaces between a member name and an opening parenthesis.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.2 Space Usage.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0055
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

## Options

```ini
csharp_space_between_method_call_name_and_opening_parenthesis = false
csharp_space_between_method_declaration_name_and_open_parenthesis = false
```

## From the book

```csharp
Right: Foo()
```
